settings.heading: Learn to Run Facebook & Instagram Ads for Your Music
settings.highlight: Without Wasting Money Guessing What Works.
settings.intro: I’m Dylan Koch, touring drummer with the Koch-Marshall Trio. I’ll show you how I use Facebook and Instagram ads to promote real shows and music projects, then walk you through building a campaign of your own.
settings.learn_intro: Stop guessing what your ads are doing. We’ll work through actual campaigns, real music projects, and a live build so you can understand the decisions behind the settings.
settings.learn_note: Bring a show, release, merch offer, or list-building idea to think through as we go. You don't need polished video or a huge audience to follow along. This is a practical starting point, with room to keep learning as you put it into practice.
settings.bio:
I'm Dylan Koch, touring drummer with the Koch-Marshall Trio. Alongside playing music, I've spent years working on the marketing side of things, running ads for shows, promoting releases, building audiences, and figuring out how to get music in front of people.

This workshop is built around that experience.

settings.proof_heading: On Tour. Running the Ads. Teaching From Experience.
settings.proof_text: We play roughly 180 shows a year. On our current tour, dates in Los Angeles, San Francisco, Carson City, and Nevada City have sold out. I’ve been running Meta ads to promote those shows. This workshop draws on that hands-on experience.
settings.urgency: Touring keeps me busy most of the year, so I don’t teach these live workshops often. On December 19, I’m making time to walk you through the process and answer questions.

settings.title: Choosing the right campaign
settings.text: Match your objective to the job: promoting a show, a release, merch, or an email signup. Understand what you're asking Meta to find.

settings.title: Making ads using existing creative assets
settings.text: Turn photos, performance clips, and material you already have into clear ads. We'll look at the creative and the words that support it.

settings.title: Finding the right audience
settings.text: Work through location, audience choices, and a starting budget. Make decisions that fit the project instead of copying random settings.

settings.title: Building a campaign in Meta Ads Manager
settings.text: Watch a campaign come together live, step by step. See where the creative, audience, budget, and destination fit into the setup.

settings.title: Growing an email list
settings.text: Learn how an incentive and a clear signup path can help turn attention into subscribers who want to hear from you again.

settings.title: Reading and understanding results
settings.text: Look beyond clicks. Learn which costs and outcomes to examine, where tracking has limits, and what to consider before changing a campaign.

settings.title: Do I need previous advertising experience?
settings.text: No. We'll work through the basics in plain language. Have access to Meta Ads Manager if you'd like to follow along, or watch and use the replay later. Any advertising spend is separate from your ticket.

settings.title: Is the workshop suitable for solo artists and bands?
settings.text: Yes. The examples and decisions apply to solo artists and bands promoting shows, releases, merch, or an email list.

settings.title: What if I cannot attend live?
settings.text: Both tickets include the main workshop replay. You'll be able to revisit the examples and work through the setup at your own pace.

settings.title: What is included with VIP?
settings.text: VIP is $57 total and includes the main workshop, replay, and a separate group Zoom coaching/Q&A from 3:30–4:30 PM Central on December 19. There is a half-hour break after the main workshop. Bring questions about your advertising goals. Individual audits and one-on-one coaching are not included.

settings.title: How will my access details arrive?
settings.text: Use an email address you can access at checkout. Main workshop and replay details will be emailed before the event. VIP Zoom details will be confirmed separately. There's no separate registration, and marketing consent is optional. The optional subscriber PDF is delivered separately.

settings.title: Will anything be sold to me at the end?
settings.text: No. This is a standalone paid educational workshop with no closing sales pitch.
